economy.switch: THE ONE SWITCH. economy.issuing in this file. false (today): the station's tick function (cobblers:research_station/tick, run every tick by #minecraft:tick) REMOVES the tags cobblers_station_issuing and cobblers_station_issuing_crown from every player, and the pack ships none of the earning advancements (the storm log, the ember survey, the lake trio, the courier's delivery). Every option that offers an item and every transition that gives one, in all four conversations, requires cobblers_station_issuing (the crown cobblers_station_issuing_crown); the transitions check it server-side, not only the option's visibility. So no item is given, and none can be earned. true: rebuild the pack (python tools/research_station.py build), install it, restart: the tick function ADDS cobblers_station_issuing to every player, the four earning advancements ship, and the options appear to players who meet each route's gate. The crown also needs post_champion_cap measured at 70 or more (Calyrex is a fixed level 70): until then cobblers_station_issuing_crown is never added, whatever issuing says. The dews also need eon_issuing true: until then cobblers_station_issuing_eon is never added (eon_issuing_why). tools/research_station_audit.py checks both states of issuing and the crown; the eon tag is not in its tick check yet (for the test author).

ember_survey.box_from: data/adopted_legendary_sites.json adopted_moltres_tower placement (corner, y, size; rotation none): x6252-6282, y168-231, z5344-5377 in the overworld
ember_survey.why: the tower is pasted by /place template (its placement.command), which writes no structure reference into the chunk, so the old minecraft:location predicate on the structure cobbleverse:legendary/moltres could never fire there. A location predicate on a POSITION box needs nothing from the world: the same usage as storm_log here and the trigger boxes of tools/rewards_pack.py (criterion minecraft:location, player predicate location.position + dimension). The whole box, not one storey: the template's interior was not read beyond its altar at template [14,1,16] (docs/research/notes/legendary-catalogue-reopened.md section 2). Until the tower is pasted the box is open ground on the cone's flank (issuing_open_2026_10_02 b)

kubfu_check.starters_from: data/mythical_starters.json lines[id=starter_kubfu].stages (species and form of every stage)
kubfu_check.why: the Director's scroll options and their transitions require the player tag economy.tags.kubfu_partner, kept by a Cobblemon player_tick_pre callback this pack ships (tools/lopunny_house.py's party read, the water ladder's, EXP-042): once a second it tags a player whose party holds a Pokemon of the starter's species in one of the starter's forms, and untags them otherwise. Read by form_name, not by aspect: Cobblemon 1.8.0's Pokemon MoLang struct has form_name (FormData.getName as a string) and aspects (an array, which would need a loop inside the party loop, never used here), and no has_aspect; both were read from PokemonMoLangFunctions.class with javap 2026-10-03. A form is chosen by its forced aspect (data/mythical_starters.json), so the form name is the aspect's witness and a wild Kubfu, in the standard form, is never matched. Shipped in both states of economy.issuing: it says only who has the partner; the issuing tag still holds the give

silvally_check.starters_from: data/mythical_starters.json lines[id=starter_typenull].stages (species and form of every stage) and its final (species only)
silvally_check.why: kubfu_check's shape, for the memories (economy.items silvally_memories): the Director's memory option and its transition require the player tag economy.tags.silvally_partner, kept once a second by this callback. Type: Null is matched by species AND form name in each of its two starter forms, so a wild Type: Null (standard form) is never matched. Silvally cannot be matched that way: the starter's evolution result is 'silvally unaspect=cobblers_starter_2' (data/mythical_starters.json starter_typenull), so a starter Silvally carries no starter form, and its form follows the memory it holds (Normal and the 17 type forms of data/cobblemon/species/generation7/silvally.json in the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar, read 2026-10-08). So Silvally is matched by species alone, in any form; a player who reaches the Director after the evolution is still served. The cost: any Silvally qualifies, and neither species has a spawn in data/spawns.json or a spawn file in the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar (checked 2026-10-08). Shipped in both states of economy.issuing: it says only who has the partner; the issuing tag still holds the give
